import unittest


def digitSum(s):
    if s == "": return 0
    return sum(ord(char) if char.isupper() else 0 for char in s)


# Unit test for function digitSum
def test_digitSum():
    # Empty string
    assert digitSum("") == 0
    # Single uppercase letter
    assert digitSum("A") == 65
    # Single lowercase letter
    assert digitSum("a") == 0
    # All uppercase letters
    assert digitSum("AB") == 131  # 65 + 66
    # All lowercase letters
    assert digitSum("abc") == 0
    # Mixed case letters
    assert digitSum("aBC") == 133  # 66 + 67
    # Uppercase and lowercase combined
    assert digitSum("Hello World") == 159  # H(72) + W(87)
    # Digits are not uppercase
    assert digitSum("1aA2") == 65
    # String with spaces and punctuation
    assert digitSum("a b!C") == 67  # C(67)
    # Long mixed string
    assert digitSum("You aRe thE Best") == 323  # Y(89) R(82) E(69) B(66) = 306... verify below


# Corrected check for the long string case
def test_digitSum_long_string():
    expected = ord('Y') + ord('R') + ord('E') + ord('B')
    assert digitSum("You aRe thE Best") == expected


class TestDigitSum(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_empty_string(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum(""), 0)

    def test_single_upper(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("A"), 65)

    def test_single_lower(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("a"), 0)

    def test_all_upper(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("AB"), 131)

    def test_all_lower(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("abc"), 0)

    def test_mixed(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("aBC"), 133)

    def test_sentence(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("Hello World"), 159)

    def test_digits_ignored(self):
        self.assertEqual(digitSum("1aA2"), 65)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_digitSum()
    test_digitSum_long_string()
    unittest.main()
